criteria.requirement: Implement feedgen.pagination.paginate(feed,page,page_size,base_url,*,order_by=None,reverse=True) returning frozen FeedPage(feed,number,total_pages,total_entries). Reuse completed deep copy and optional stable date ordering. Positive pages/sizes, one empty page for empty feed and explicit out-of-range errors. Preserve root feed ID/metadata/other link relations, replace only self/first/last/prev/next with correct HTTP(S) page URLs; replace duplicate page query parameters while preserving unrelated query pairs and fragments. Source entries/links stay unchanged and result must serialize through actual Atom.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
